remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this Glenbrook 1-bedroom with heat and hot water included! Step inside this meticulously maintained unit to find a bright, open concept living room/Kitchen, spacious bedroom and a large bathroom. Storage won't be an issue with plenty of closet space and an additional large private storage cage located next to the on-site Laundry in basement. Outside, you'll find one reserved parking space ensuring hassle-free parking. Plus, with easy access to the Glenbrook Train Station just a 6-minute walk away, commuting is a breeze! Walking distance to nearby restaurants, shops and entertainment. All conveniently situated near I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, don't miss out on this opportunity! Schedule your viewing today!
